about: How to say words a voice model reads wrong ("Claude" as "Cloud"). voice/speak.py says each sentence as written first and uses these spoken spellings on the rounds after Whisper hears it wrong (--respell auto), every round (always) or never. write = the word as written (whole word, case kept), say = how to spell it so it is said right. pattern entries are regular expressions (Python re, \1 = the first group). Spoken forms from the 2026-10-30 voice test (barnaby-studio imagegen/compare/voice/lines_hard.json) and docs/research/VOICE-TTS-2026-10.md there.
